Titles.eng: Kuroko's Basketball Movie 2: Winter Cup Highlights - Beyond the Tears
Titles.jpn: Kuroko no Basket Movie 2: Winter Cup Soushuuhen - Namida no Saki e

Summaries.eng: Throughout two important Winter Cup matches, two members of the Generation of Miracles, Kise and Murasakibara, are defeated.
Summaries.jpn: Sōshitsu no tēma wa eiga no omona shōtendeari, kiseki no sedai no 2-ri no menbā, Kise to Murasakibaru no haiboku de sore o shimeshite imasu. Matchi ga 1tsu shika toriage rarenakatta saisho no eiga to wa kotonari, 2-banme no eiga ni wa hiromi kōkō tai ao Hayashi kōkō to umishiro kōkō tai ao Hayashi kōkō no 2tsu no shiai ga fukuma rete imasu.

Aliases: Winter Cup Highlights Episode 2 – Winter Cup Highlights -Beyond the Tears
